intro: Looking for your next escape? Varanasi delivers: india's oldest living city on the Ganga. Here is everything you need to plan a trip.

sections.heading: Why visit Varanasi
paragraphs: Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh) is known for its spiritual, heritage and culture experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to March.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Sunrise boat ride along the ghats
Sarnath, where the Buddha gave his first sermon

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly into Lal Bahadur Shastri Airport or take one of many trains to Varanasi Junction.

sections.heading: Where to stay
list: Assi Ghat for cafés and calm

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Hire a boat at dawn rather than evening — the light and the quiet are worth the early alarm.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Varanasi?

faq.a: Fly into Lal Bahadur Shastri Airport or take one of many trains to Varanasi Junction.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Varanasi?
faq.a: Popular choices: Assi Ghat for cafés and calm; Dashashwamedh area for the aarti; Cantonment for modern hotels.
